scope: CRC-only Recovery App integrity metadata; not a publisher signature
nativeUse: Use the existing native length/CRC/boot-validation record if it already binds the complete App; do not add this descriptor redundantly
Where an equivalent complete-App CRC record does not exist, append IKCI immediately after the exact App body and before the existing native publisher-signature wrapper
Signed Pro signs body plus IKCI using the existing native wrapper/key/context, so older signature-checking Recovery can still accept the new Pro App
Unsigned Free appends IKCI without a signing step; retain the platform native image/container header where required
bodyBytes excludes IKCI and all outer signature/native transport trailers; bodyCrc32 covers exactly that body
nativeBoardContext/nativeLayoutContext reuse existing exact platform signing or image contexts; record mappings explicitly without product-name guessing
Cold boot/resume must locate metadata using native bounds/lengths; any bounded locator must require bodyBytes equal the descriptor offset from the App base and independently verify both CRCs
Reject truncated, overflowing, wrong-context, wrong-epoch, unsupported flags/reserved/schema or ambiguous descriptors; never treat a recomputed CRC compared with itself as stored integrity proof
No new partition, unknown-layout fallback, persistent boot seed or Pro App handshake is introduced
Measure the 40-byte package metadata separately from linked App code and Recovery cost
